_what: H-C slate-unique IDF mass: the IDF mass a head candidate carries that NO OTHER depth-10 slate member carries, as a fraction of its total mass, scored on FLIPS.
_instrument_only: Nothing ships. No artifact minted, no gate refit, no held-out read.

_registered_prediction.correlation_with_non_query_mass_norm_gap: > 0.5; if so this is the dead feature in new clothes

slate_unique_frac_primary.description: PRIMARY: (slate-unique IDF mass / total IDF mass), rank2 minus rank1; comparison set = the other 9 slate members, head pair included

harness.description: PRIMARY: (slate-unique IDF mass / total IDF mass), rank2 minus rank1; comparison set = the other 9 slate members, head pair included

verdict._caveat: best tau is chosen on fit, on the same 229 pairs the feature is scored on. A positive net here is a design signal, NEVER a result. It needs a held-out read at a FIXED tau before it is evidence of anything.
